topArticle.title: Norway mourns King Harald as Haakon VIII ascends throne
topArticle.description: Mourners gather outside the palace as royals, politicians and citizens remember a beloved king, whose son has adopted the family motto "all for norway".

topArticle.title: Russia ramps up rhetoric but wants to avoid war with Nato, Western officials say
topArticle.description: But they say Moscow will likely continue its "hybrid activity" against Nato members, short of direct military action.

topArticle.title: Detroit despairs as ‘insanity’ of Trump’s Canada trade war punishes city
topArticle.description:
Unpopular new policy comes as midterms loom and control of Congress could be decided by several Michigan races
Every day $1bn worth of goods crosses the river dividing Detroit, Michigan, and Windsor, Ontario, two largely blue-collar US and Canadian cities that have come to act as one in the creation of North America’s auto industry.
News this week of Donald Trump’s escalating trade spat with Canada has everyone worried. Political and economic leaders and observers labeled the move an act of “hubris” , blamed Trump’s “ego”, and called the escalation “insanity”.
 Continue reading...
topArticle.titleJa: トランプのカナダとの貿易戦争がデトロイトを苦しめ、「狂気」に絶望
topArticle.summary: ドナルド・トランプ大統領のカナダとの貿易戦争が激化し、デトロイトの経済に深刻な影響を与えている。ミシガン州の選挙戦にも影響が出ると予想される。

topArticle.title: Egyptian queen’s 673-diamond necklace stolen in Vienna smash-and-grab raid
topArticle.description:
Police hunt two suspects after historic 200-carat piece is snatched from Austrian museum during opening hours
Austrian police are hunting two men alleged to have stolen a 200-carat platinum necklace encrusted with 673 diamonds that was on loan to a museum in Vienna and once belonged to Egyptian royalty.
Authorities in the capital released pictures of the suspects captured by security cameras during the heist at the Museum of Applied Arts (MAK), amid a rash of spectacular smash-and-grab thefts from European cultural institutions.
 Continue reading...
topArticle.titleJa: エジプト女王の673個のダイヤモンドネックレス、ウィーンで強奪される

topArticle.title: Greenland says findings on genocide allegation not final

topArticle.title: Germany news: Baltic summit plans hybrid-threat task force

topArticle.title: What next? Kurds say yes, Druze still say no to united Syria

topArticle.title: Rwanda genocide: Dutch court sentences man to life in prison

topArticle.title: UK urged to help free British-Egyptian ‘arrested in Cairo over sister’s activism’
topArticle.description:
Lawyers claim Eman el-Shazly, from Birmingham, was detained in effort to silence her sister, a critic of Sisi regime
The UK Foreign Office has been asked to intervene to secure the release of a British-Egyptian woman who it is claimed has been arrested in Cairo because of her sister’s political activism.
Eman el-Shazly, a 45-year-old based in Birmingham, was arrested on 16 August while visiting Egypt. Her lawyers say she has been detained in an attempt to silence her sister Mona, a relentless and harsh critic of the Egyptian government on her UK-based YouTube channel.
 Continue reading...
topArticle.titleJa: 英国、姉の活動を理由にカイロで逮捕された英エジプト人女性の釈放を支援するよう要請される

topArticle.title: South African police arrest two Thai men for allegedly smuggling parrot eggs
topArticle.description:
Bird eggs intercepted in homemade incubators at Johannesburg airport as officials try to halt wildlife trafficking
South African police have arrested two Thai nationals in separate incidents for allegedly attempting to smuggle endangered parrot eggs out of the country as authorities try to stem the tide of wildlife trafficking.
A 50-year-old Thai national was arrested at OR Tambo international airport in Johannesburg on 20 August, carrying 50 bird eggs in a homemade incubator in a hand-luggage bag, South Africa’s environment ministry said in a statement.
 Continue reading...
topArticle.titleJa: 南アフリカ警察、オウムの卵密輸容疑でタイ人男性2人を逮捕

topArticle.title: How much will it take to rebuild Venezuela after the earthquakes?

topArticle.summary: ブラジルでは政治的・経済的圧力により、先住民族に対する暴力や土地紛争が激化。権利の枠組みや土地の境界画定における対立が背景にある。

topArticle.title: Lithuania gives EUR 30,000 to help developing economies and LDCs improve trade skillset
topArticle.description: Lithuania is contributing EUR 30,000 (approximately CHF 28,000) in 2026 to finance training programmes for government officials from developing economies, including least-developed countries (LDCs). This contribution to the WTO Global Trust Fund will support these economies in deepening their expertise on WTO issues and help them participate more effectively in the rules-based multilateral trading system.
topArticle.titleJa: リトアニア、発展途上国およびLDCの貿易スキル向上を支援するため3万ユーロを拠出
topArticle.summary: リトアニアは、発展途上国や後発開発途上国の政府職員向け研修プログラムに3万ユーロを拠出し、WTO問題の専門知識向上を支援する。

topArticle.title: Uzbekistan reaffirms 2026 WTO accession goal, thanks members for continuing engagement
topArticle.description: Uzbekistan reaffirmed its determination to complete its WTO accession process within 2026 at a meeting of the Working Party on the Accession of Uzbekistan on 27 and 28 July, soon after its last meeting in March. The head of Uzbekistan's delegation, Chief Negotiator Azizbek Urunov, stressed that maintaining a strong pace of engagement and addressing members' remaining concerns will be critical to bringing the accession process to a successful conclusion.
topArticle.titleJa: ウズベキスタン、2026年のWTO加盟目標を再確認し、継続的な関与に感謝
topArticle.summary: ウズベキスタンは、2026年内のWTO加盟プロセス完了への決意を再確認し、加盟国に継続的な関与への感謝を表明した。
